about: Limits for judging a foot or hand bone against the floor. Working values chosen for mstack. None was read from a primary source; tune them for the character's size and the engine before treating a fail as final.

contact_height_m.unit: metres above the floor that still count as contact
contact_height_m.source: mstack working value, no primary source
contact_height_m.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

below_floor_m.unit: metres under the floor before it is a fail
below_floor_m.source: mstack working value, no primary source
below_floor_m.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_slide_m.unit: metres of sideways travel inside one contact
max_slide_m.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_slide_m.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_scale_drift_pct.unit: percent change of the bone's world scale against the rest pose
max_scale_drift_pct.source: mstack working value, no primary source
max_scale_drift_pct.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

skeleton_growth_warn_pct.unit: percent growth of the box around all bone origins; warning only
skeleton_growth_warn_pct.source: mstack working value, no primary source
skeleton_growth_warn_pct.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number
